{{Quote|Missiles fired! Missiles fired, full spray! Sensors detect multiple warheads on each with radioactive signature. They're ''nuclear'', Admiral.|[[Dallan Morvis]] to [[Saul Karath]]|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 15">[[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]]</ref>}}
'''Nuclear weapons,''' or alternatively '''nuclear bombs''', '''nuclear missiles''',<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> '''nuclear warheads''',<ref name="Sourcebook">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> or '''nuclear devices'''<ref name="RescuedAliens">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20011115a_slug&c=rpg|text=Rescued Aliens: Swamp Slug and Stone Mite}}</ref> were powerful explosives whose power derived from nuclear reactions and were capable of ruining entire neighborhoods or cities. The bombs left residual [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] after their detonation.

==Description==
The nuclear weapons used by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] were [[Color/Legends|silver]] [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] with long, tubular bodies and red nose cones. On the aft end of their silver bodies, they had four fins.

==History==
{{Quote|This&hellip;is a new phase of the war. We're going to have to change the way we look at things.|Karath on the Mandalorian's devastation of Serroco|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 15" />}}
[[File:CourageousMissiles.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Nuclear bombs swerve around the [[Courageous (Inexpugnable-class)|''Courageous'']] during the [[Battle of Serroco]].]]

In [[3963 BBY]], after [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] invaded [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and initiated the Mandalorian Wars, the Mandalorians procured a supply of nuclear missiles. On the eve of the [[Battle of Serroco]], several [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] experienced [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] of a Mandalorian [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]] that would devastate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Serroco]]'s surface. A former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Zayne Carrick]], who was actually on that world when he saw this stowed away aboard a Republic ship and announced that he was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] so he would be taken to their [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Courageous (Inexpugnable-class)|''Courageous'']]. However, upon discovering that Carrick had been accused of perpetrating the [[Padawan Massacre]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] the commander of the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], [[Saul Karath]] became convinced that he was misleading them on behalf of the Mandalorians.

Nuclear weapons were also used during the [[Disaster on Jebble|Battle of Jebble]] by [[Cassus Fett]] to completely wipe out the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]] that had spread to many of the Mandalorians there. This led to a sudden and severe melting of the ice that covered the [[Jebble|planet]].

It was said that [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernauts]] could produce heat levels approaching that of a nuclear bomb.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith: Incredible Cross-Sections">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] (alter ego of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Palpatine of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]) orchestrated the execution of a complex plot<ref name="Lockdown">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''</ref> involving the procurement of a proscribed nuclear weapon to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] his own [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] (alter ego of [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|IBC]] kingpin Hego Damask).<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> To accomplish this, he covertly solicited, then manipulated the services of<ref name="Lockdown" /> some of the galaxy's most feared [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] and organizations, including [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] overlord [[Alexi Garyn]] and notorious gambler [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]], all of whom, in some way, held Damask in contempt. Foremost among them was [[King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] of Naboo, who felt Damask was working to undermine his wealth-building ventures and remove him from the throne;<ref name="Plagueis" /> Sidious led<ref name="Lockdown" /> Veruna to believe that the King himself was the originator and organizer of the nuclear-weapons plot (indeed, it was Veruna who would issue the actual order) to kill Damask.<ref name="Plagueis" />

Meanwhile, Sidious sent his [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]-[[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] to [[Mission to Cog Hive Seven|infiltrate]] the 'gambling prison' [[Cog Hive Seven]], [[Maul: Lockdown|secure]] the nuclear device from the prison's enigmatic recluse [[Iram Radique]], and deliver the bomb to [[Komari Vosa]] and her [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]]<ref name="Lockdown" />&mdash;who would then [[Bombing of Sojourn|deliver it]] to its target: the obscure [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]], Plagueis' private outpost. The mission failed, however, and Damask survived to mete out [[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter|vengeance]] on those responsible. Sidious, of course, oversaw most of the [[Alexi Garyn#Enemy of the Sith|avenging missions]], as his master, in the end, did not hold him suspect as one who would eliminate him by nuclear blast (such as was Veruna, whose final fate Plagueis attended to himself).<ref name="Plagueis" />

An Imperial nuclear warhead was captured by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] from the freighter ''[[Gafra]]'' during [[Operation Strike Fear]]. The warhead was then smuggled onto the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Invincible (Strike Fear)|''Invincible'']], destroying it from the inside.<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>

By the time period shortly following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], nuclear weapons were usually found only in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] or beyond.<ref name="The Star Wars Sourcebook">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>

[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] believed the planet [[Shiva IV]] to have been the setting for a devastating war in which nuclear bombs had been used.<ref name="Star Wars 1977 53">[[Star Wars (1977) 53|''Star Wars'' (1977) 53]]</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]] later tried to bombard the planet with [[anti-matter bomb]]s, but was stopped by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
